command: const fs=require("fs"),p=require("path"),c=require("crypto");const out=process.argv[1];const lp=p.join(out,"execution-log.json");const log=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(lp,"utf8"));const draft=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p.join(out,"validation-draft.json"),"utf8"));const pub=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p.join(out,"validation-publish.json"),"utf8"));const digest=c.createHash("sha256").update(fs.readFileSync(p.join(out,"ruta.koraz-route.json"))).digest("hex");if(!draft.valid||pub.publishable||digest!==log.packageSha256)throw Error("Inconsistent final artifacts");log.completedFinalAuthorRun={command:[process.execPath,p.join(out,"author-route.mjs")],exitCode:0,result:"valid:true, publishable:false; final hash verified"};log.additionalReadCommand={command:"Get-Content -LiteralPath <output>/validation-publish.json -Raw",exitCode:0,result:"Full portable diagnostics inspected"};log.finalCheck={exitCode:0,packageSha256:digest,valid:draft.valid,publishable:pub.publishable,portableErrorCount:pub.issues.filter(x=>x.severity==="error").length,command:[process.execPath,"-e",process.argv[0],out]};fs.writeFileSync(lp,JSON.stringify(log,null,2)+"\n");console.log(JSON.stringify(log.finalCheck));
